solution:

    Ta có −1≤sinx≤1,∀x∈ℝ⇔−2≤2sinx≤2⇔−7≤2sinx−5≤−3hay−7≤y≤−3.
    Vậy maxℝy=−3 khi sinx=1⇔x=π2+k2π,k∈ℤ.
  4. f(x)=g(x)⇔sinx=sin(π2−x)⇔[x=π2−x+k2πx=π−π2+x+k2π⇔x=π4+kπ,k∈ℤ.
